verdict.rationale: Aider is a local coding agent, and some products of this kind expose an HTTP API with a published spec, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no machine-readable API spec: probes of the usual OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The documented Python scripting interface (Coder.create / coder.run) is an API, but it is not a downloadable machine-readable spec and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
